English.Char_Desc_45: Mark stream highlights with a hotkey
English.Char_Desc_80: Mark stream highlights live and export CSV or YouTube chapters locally.
English.Char_Desc_250: MarkMyVOD Lite is a free Windows utility that records timestamped stream highlights through a global hotkey. Add notes, edit markers, save sessions, and export CSV files or YouTube chapter lists without uploading footage.
English.Char_Desc_450: MarkMyVOD Lite helps streamers and video creators mark moments while a recording is running. Press Ctrl + Shift + M from any Windows app to record a timestamp, then add notes, edit markers, save or restore the session, and export CSV files or YouTube chapter lists. Lite supports up to 10 markers per session and requires no account, installer, cloud upload, tracking, advertising, generated media, or FFmpeg.
English.Char_Desc_2000: MarkMyVOD Lite is a free Windows utility for streamers and video creators who want to mark moments while recording instead of rewatching an entire VOD. Start a session when recording begins and press Ctrl + Shift + M from any Windows app to record a timestamp. Each marker can include a type and note, and markers can be added manually, edited, or deleted. Sessions can be saved and restored. The Lite edition exports a UTF-8 CSV file and a ready-to-paste YouTube chapter list, supports up to 10 markers per session, and requires no installer, account, cloud upload, telemetry, advertising, generated media, or FFmpeg. The application stays local unless the user clicks the clearly labeled link to the separate full version. The full version removes the marker limit and adds JSON, CMX 3600 EDL, and exact local MP4 clip export.

Permissions.Distribution_Permissions: MarkMyVOD Lite may be freely redistributed only as the original, unmodified release ZIP and without charging for the software itself. It may not be modified, resold, sublicensed, or bundled with other software.
